Join the chemistry community at IU Indianapolis
As a chemistry and chemical biology student in the School of Science, you’ll join a small, close-knit community dedicated to improving the world through chemical science.
You can earn a degree accredited by the American Chemical Society at a variety of levels:
B.A. in Chemistry
B.S. in Chemistry
Minor in Chemistry
Master’s in Chemistry with a thesis or no-thesis option
Ph.D.
Undergraduate students are admitted to our department through IU Indianapolis and the School of Science.
Learn how to apply as an undergraduate student
How to apply to a chemistry graduate program
To apply to our master’s or Ph.D. program, you should have a baccalaureate degree from an accredited institution, show promise of ability to engage in advanced work, and have completed at least 35 credit hours of chemistry broadly representative of the fields of the discipline in a chemistry curriculum.
When you’re ready to start the admissions process, you’ll begin by completing the online IU Indianapolis Graduate Application.
Apply now
What to submit with your application
A successful application includes several components.
Personal statement
The personal statement is part of the online application. Please tell us about your goals and plans and what specific area(s) of chemistry you’re interested in.
Letters of recommendation
We require three letters of recommendation from people familiar with you and your student and/or professional career.
NOTE: If you have completed the online university application and have listed contact information for your recommenders, they will receive an automatic letter request through which they can submit their letter. You will not need to request mailed hard copies. In lieu of that, letters on letterhead are also acceptable and should be mailed to the department in care of Graduate Admissions.
Transcripts
One original copy of the official transcript(s) of all previous university work is required. International students must also provide the official degree certificate. Both should be sealed and signed by the university.
Please arrange for official hard copies to be sent to the department in care of Graduate Admissions. All degrees awarded should be documented. A list of university courses and their titles which do not appear on the transcript(s) should also be sent to the department:
Graduate Admissions Committee
Department of Chemistry and Chemical Biology
IU Indianapolis
402 N. Blackford Street, LD 326
Indianapolis, IN 46202-3274
GRE
The Graduate Record Examination general test is optional.
The chemistry exam is not required but will be considered if a score is submitted.
Please have the documentation of your score sent directly to IU Indianapolis from the Educational Testing Service using the IUI code: 1325.
TOEFL
International students must take the TOEFL.
The minimum scores required for admission are:
Overall–80 iBT
Listening–16
Reading–19
Speaking–22
Writing–18
As an alternative to the TOEFL, we will consider the IELTS with a bandwidth of 6.5. Please have the documentation of your scores sent directly to IU Indianapolis from the Educational Testing Service using the IUI code: 1325.
Application deadlines
To ensure your application receives complete consideration for departmental fellowships and other financial support, all materials for full-time study should be completed by January 15 for entry in the following fall semester.
Late applications will be considered only if positions are available.
Applications for part-time graduate admission may be submitted up to two months prior to your intended starting date.
